one_line_description.value: Pinterest's developer platform exposes APIs that let apps create and manage organic Pins and Boards, shopping catalogs and shopping ads, conversions, and analytics.
one_line_description.quote: Build apps and experiences that allow Pinterest users to create and manage organic content (Pins and Boards) on Pinterest.

has_public_api.quote: Pinterest API helps you ingest analytics data for content and ads directly from Pinterest into your data warehouse or analytics tools.

api_breadth.value: Broad read-write surface: Pins, Boards, ads, audiences, catalogs, analytics and conversions; endpoint count not stated in the evidence.
api_breadth.quote: The Pinterest API v5 significantly increases the scope of what is possible for you to create as a developer.

auth_methods.quote: OAuth 2.0 authorization and granular permissions keep credentials protected and access appropriately controlled.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Each scope allows your app to make different API requests, such as for creating ads or viewing secret boards.

access_model.quote: If approved for API use, your app receives Trial access, which is best for exploring our API features.

access_notes.value: Requires a business account and app registration; the app secret is only issued after Pinterest approves the app, and approved apps receive Trial access (daily limits, Pins/Boards visible only to the creator). Upgrading to Standard access additionally requires submitting a video recording of your app completing an OAuth flow for review.
access_notes.quote: If your app is pending Pinterest approval, you cannot see your app secret.

rate_limits.value: Tiered: Trial access is limited by calls per day per app; Standard access is limited more granularly by calls per minute per user per app. Specific numeric quotas are documented at /docs/reference/rate-limits/ but numbers were not captured in the evidence.
rate_limits.quote: Apps with Trial access are rate limited based on calls per day/per app. Apps with Standard access are rate limited at a more granular level at calls per minute/per user/per app.

webhooks.quote: Webhook URL: The webhook_url should follow the HTTPS protocol and adhere to standard webhook behavior without authentication or authorization.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: Read more on our [API Sandbox](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/developer-tools/sandbox/) and other supported capabilities.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: API is versioned as v5 (documentation and paths under /docs/api/v5/); an explicit deprecation/sunset policy was not found in the captured evidence.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: The Pinterest API v5 significantly increases the scope of what is possible for you to create as a developer.

verdict_reason: Pinterest documents a broad public API v5 with OAuth 2.0, documented scopes, an API sandbox and webhooks for lead ads. Access is nonetheless gated by Pinterest app review: approved apps receive Trial access, the app secret is hidden while approval is pending, and Standard access requires a recorded video review of the OAuth flow. That approval gate, rather than credentials cost, makes it moderate rather than easy.
main_blocker: Pinterest app approval before app secret/Trial access; video review for Standard access
outreach_reason: A human must submit the app for Pinterest review, and for Standard access prepare a video recording of the app completing the OAuth flow, before credentials/production access are granted.
open_questions: The fetched API introduction and /docs/ pages rendered as JS navigation shells with no body text, so api_type (REST) and the canonical docs_url are inferred rather than stated verbatim; evidence explicitly calls API endpoints but never labels the protocol.
Official SDK languages could not be verified: the developer-tools/sdk page was not captured in SOURCES, so sdk_languages is left not_found.
Specific numeric rate-limit quotas are referenced on /docs/reference/rate-limits/ but were not present in the captured text.
No explicit deprecation/sunset policy was found in the captured pages; only the v5 version designation is evidenced.

The official Pinterest MCP server page says 'Be the first to know when it launches' and a help page snippet mentions early-access sign-up, so the https://api.pinterest.com/mcp endpoint may not yet be generally available.
Whether Trial app approval is a human outreach process or an automated portal review is not fully clear; access_notes/outreach assume a review submission is required.
